claim: `tprod_nonneg` assumes `[L.NeBot]`, but the statement holds for every summation filter: when `¬L.NeBot`, `∏'[L]` is a `finprod` (`tprod_bot`), which is nonnegative by `finprod_induction`. Every sibling bound in this file (`one_le_tprod`/`tsum_nonneg`, `tprod_le_one`, `tprod_le_of_prod_le'`) drops `L.NeBot` exactly this way, so the new lemma is strictly weaker than its neighbours, and a `positivity` extension for `tprod` modelled on `evalTsum` (lines 378-399, which calls `tsum_nonneg` with an arbitrary `L`) could not use it, since it would have to synthesize `L.NeBot`.
requested_change:
Remove `[L.NeBot]` from `tprod_nonneg` and handle the degenerate filter the way `tprod_le_one` does. Use `i` as the bound variable to match the siblings:
```lean
theorem tprod_nonneg [CommMonoidWithZero α] [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α] [ZeroLEOneClass α]
    [PosMulMono α] [ClosedIciTopology α] {f : ι → α} (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) :
    0 ≤ ∏'[L] i, f i := by
  by_cases h : Multipliable f L
  · by_cases hL : L.NeBot
    · exact le_hasProd_of_le_prod h.hasProd fun s ↦ prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hf i
    · simp only [tprod_bot hL]
      exact finprod_induction (0 ≤ ·) zero_le_one (fun _ _ ↦ mul_nonneg) hf
  · rw [tprod_eq_one_of_not_multipliable h]
    exact zero_le_one
```
